tools.name: get_pro_screener_result
tools.description: Fetch compact comparable results and analysis summary for an existing Pro Screener session. Use this when an appraiser wants to review evidence already generated by Pro Screener. No login is required for those sessions. Private client packets still use a short-lived signed URL. Never publish customer PDFs to /appraisals or /sessions.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_public_sample_report, create_appraisal_start_link, get_artist, search_silver_hallmarks, get_silver_hallmark, create_pro_screener_workspace_link, search_pro_screener_comparables, get_pro_screener_result, get_pro_screener_pdf · Private data: search, fetch, create_appraisal_start_link, search_silver_hallmarks, create_pro_screener_workspace_link, start_pro_screener_run, get_pro_screener_status, get_pro_screener_result, get_pro_screener_pdf · Public sink: search, create_appraisal_start_link, create_pro_screener_workspace_link, get_pro_screener_pdf · Destructive: start_pro_screener_run, start_promotional_pro_screener_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_public_sample_report, create_appraisal_start_link, get_artist, search_silver_hallmarks, get_silver_hallmark, create_pro_screener_workspace_link, search_pro_screener_comparables, get_pro_screener_result, get_pro_screener_pdf · Private data: search, fetch, create_appraisal_start_link, search_silver_hallmarks, create_pro_screener_workspace_link, start_pro_screener_run, get_pro_screener_status, get_pro_screener_result, get_pro_screener_pdf · Public sink: search, create_appraisal_start_link, create_pro_screener_workspace_link, get_pro_screener_pdf · Destructive: start_pro_screener_run, start_promotional_pro_screener_run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
